title: WizDish + Oculus Rift Professional demo
description: We had a blast taking the WizDish to Inition in London.  They are probably the biggest supplier of 3D and VR equipment in the UK and we were excited to see how a top end commercial company would react.  Despite my pleas that they get accustomed to the WizDish, the Rift and TF2 in turn most of them just dived straight in with all at the same time.  None of these people had tried the WizDish before.  Head and foot tracking will be improved so it becomes even more stable.  Despite that everyone loved it!
author: Wizdish
